name: Heroll: IF
description:
About This Game

The town lies in ruins, the world has been turned upside down, and the hero may be… just a little unhinged.

HEROLL: IF is a roguelite RPG board game where you roll two dice to shape your fate. Circle an ever-changing board, battle enemies, obtain gear and blessings, and take on unpredictable adventures.

Key Features

🎲 Roguelite Board-Game RPG — Just Keep Rolling

Every turn begins with a roll of two dice. Move across the board based on the result, then face battles, rewards, events, shops, and all kinds of surprises on the tile where you land. Each time you pass the starting point, new enemies and events are added to the board—so no two journeys are ever the same.

⚔️ Create Your Own Build: Gear, Blessings, and Augments

Earn equipment through battle and rewards, then combine blessings and augments to create your own fighting style. Push your attack power to the limit with a high-damage build, endure with defense and recovery, or use dice results and special conditions to create unconventional combinations. Every run offers a new build to discover.

🐾 Cute and Dependable Pet Companions

No hero should face the end of the world alone. Cute pets with unique combat-support abilities will join you on your journey. Use their attacks, healing, and tactical support to overcome danger and venture into deeper loops. Even in a ruined world, a reliable companion makes all the difference.

🎮 Unpredictable Events and Mini-Games

No one knows what may happen in this ruined world. Random events appear across the board, and luck-driven mini-games await—challenges that cannot be solved by combat power alone.

🔄 Rebuild the Ruined Town 

The journey does not end when a run is over. Unlock permanent progression, rebuild the town, and prepare for your next challenge through both failure and victory. Open new growth paths and content, create even stronger builds, and face dangers that once seemed impossible to overcome.
short_desc: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.
